ux_intent: Validate that the title detail page communicates availability status clearly, makes the primary borrow action prominent and above the fold, and presents metadata in a hierarchy that lets users decide quickly whether to borrow.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a title details screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Top app bar is transparent over the hero image. On scroll past the hero, it transitions to an opaque white background with a shadow. Back arrow (left, 48x48dp) and share icon (right, 48x48dp) are present in both states.

Layout:
- Hero image: full-width cover art, 390x260dp. A gradient overlay at the bottom (black, 60 % opacity).
- On the gradient: title (Title Medium, 22sp, #FFFFFF, weight 600) and author (Body Small, 14sp, #FFFFFF at 70 % opacity).
- Below the hero (scrollable content area, 16px horizontal padding, background #FFFFFF):
  - Availability badge: coloured pill, 36dp height, aligned left. Green #10B981 fill + white Caption 12sp "Available" / blue #3B82F6 + "Borrowed" / amber #F59E0B + "Wait list".
  - Primary CTA button: full-width, 48dp height. Text changes with state: "Borrow Now" (primary #6366F1 fill) / "Return" (secondary outlined) / "Join Wait List" (primary fill). 12px gap above the button.
  - Wait-list note (visible only in Wait list state): Body Small 14sp, #6B7280 — "2 people waiting" — 4px below the CTA.
  - Metadata section: vertical list of label + value pairs, 12px gap between pairs.
    - Format: Audiobook / eBook / Video
    - Length: "12 hours 34 min" or "324 pages"
    - Language: English
    - Publisher: Publisher Name
  - Description: expandable block. First 3 lines of Body Small 14sp #121212 visible. "Read more" link (Body Small 14sp, primary #6366F1) below — tapping expands the full text.
  - Reviews section: section header "Reviews" (Body Large 16sp weight 600), horizontal-scroll row of review cards.

States:
- Loading: skeleton placeholder for hero (grey 390x260dp), badge, CTA, and metadata rows.
- Available: green badge, "Borrow Now" CTA enabled.
- Borrowed (by this user): blue badge, CTA says "Return".
- Wait list: amber badge, CTA says "Join Wait List", wait-list note visible.
- Error: inline error banner below the hero — "Failed to load details. Tap to retry."

Behavior:
- Tap "Borrow Now" → confirmation bottom sheet: "Borrow [Title]?" with Confirm and Cancel buttons.
- Tap "Read more" → description block expands to show full text.
- Scroll past the hero → top app bar background fades to opaque white.

Style:
- Material 3-ish, light. Content-area background #FFFFFF. Primary #6366F1. Auto layout, responsive.

First step: Available state with hero loaded, green badge, enabled Borrow Now CTA, and the top of the metadata list visible.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the title is available for borrow
When the user views the detail screen
Then a green Available badge and an enabled Borrow Now button are both visible without scrolling

Given the title is on the wait list
When the user views the detail screen
Then an amber Wait list badge, a Join Wait List CTA, and the wait-list position note are all visible

Given the user taps Borrow Now
When the confirmation sheet appears
Then the title name is shown and both Confirm and Cancel are present and tappable

Given the description is longer than 3 lines
When the screen first loads
Then only 3 lines are visible and a Read more link is present
manual_validation_checklist: Verify the availability badge is visible above the fold in all three states and the colour + label are correct for each
Measure the primary CTA: full-width, 48dp height. Confirm the button label and style change per state
Check metadata label + value pairs: both ≥ 14sp, 12px vertical gap between pairs
Confirm the hero gradient makes title and author legible (white on gradient, not on raw image)
Show both top-app-bar states: transparent over the hero and opaque white after scrolling
Verify the Read more link is primary colour and has a touch target ≥ 48dp (pad if needed)
